troubleshooting.intro: Having issues? Find answers to common problems below.
troubleshooting.q1: I accidentally awarded a point to the wrong team
troubleshooting.a1: Use the Undo button (or press Z) to reverse the last action. You can undo multiple times if needed. Then award the point to the correct team.
troubleshooting.q2: The score is wrong - how do I fix it?
troubleshooting.a2: Go to Menu → Manual Changes → Edit Current Set Score. You can manually adjust both team scores. For historical sets, use Edit All Sets.
troubleshooting.q3: I need to undo multiple actions
troubleshooting.a3: Click the Undo button repeatedly. Each click reverses one action. The undo history is preserved until the set ends.
troubleshooting.q4: Match ended but I made a mistake
troubleshooting.a4: On the Match End screen, click "Reopen Last Set" to go back to scoring mode. Note: this will clear all collected signatures.
troubleshooting.q5: App shows "Offline" - what do I do?
troubleshooting.a5: Don't worry! The app works offline. All data is saved locally and will sync when you're back online. Continue scoring normally.
troubleshooting.q6: Changes aren't syncing to the cloud
troubleshooting.a6: Check the connection status indicator. If offline, data will sync when reconnected. You can also go to Menu → Options → manually trigger sync from the Cloud Backup section.
troubleshooting.a7: Ensure: (1) Both devices are on the same WiFi network, (2) The dashboard server is running (check Options), (3) The correct PIN is entered, (4) Firewall isn't blocking the connection.
troubleshooting.q8: App crashed - how do I recover the match?
troubleshooting.a8: On the Home screen, click "Continue Match" if the match is still in progress. If that doesn't work, use "Restore Match" to recover from the latest backup.
troubleshooting.q9: How do I restore from a backup?
troubleshooting.a9: Go to Home → Restore Match. Choose either Cloud Backup (enter Game # and PIN) or Local Backup (select a .json backup file from your device).
troubleshooting.a10: For official matches, use "Restore Match" with the Game PIN. For test matches, you'll need a local backup file if available. Enable auto-backup to prevent future data loss.

app.testMatchFailed: Could not prepare the test match: {{error}}
app.noTestMatch: There is no test match. Start a new one first.
app.deleteTestMatchBody: The test match and all its data are deleted from this device.
app.deleteTestMatchFailed: Could not delete the test match: {{error}}
app.useContinueTestMatch: This is a test match: continue it from the test match on the home screen.
app.openMatchFailed: Could not open the match. Please try again.
app.crashBody: This screen hit an error. The match is saved on this device: try again, or reload the page.

appWindow.pdfSaveUnsupported: The tablet app cannot save PDF files: the match-end approval uploads the scoresheet, or open it on a computer.

account.title: Your account
account.signInLead: Sign in with your OpenBeach account to save matches to the cloud.
account.pendingBody: Your account can score on this device, but matches reach the cloud only once it is approved. Have an invite code? Enter it here.
account.redeemed: Code accepted. Your account is approved.
account.signOutHint: On a shared court tablet, sign out when you are done. Matches stay on this device.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Matches stay on this device.
account.deleteConfirmBody: The account {{email}} and its profile are deleted for good. Matches on this device stay here.

errors.offline: No connection: this needs the internet.
errors.inviteRejected: This code is not valid (wrong, used up or expired).
errors.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

account.joinBody: This is an OpenVolley account. Join OpenBeach with the same login; an invite code or an admin then approves it. Matches stay on this device until then.
account.joined: You joined OpenBeach. It now waits for approval.

syncBanner.title: Not signed in: this match is saved on this device only
syncBanner.body: Scoring keeps working. Sign in to save it to the cloud (referee, livescore, backup); waiting changes are sent right after.
syncBanner.expiredTitle: Session expired: changes are saved on this device only
syncBanner.expiredBody: Scoring keeps working. Sign in again to save it to the cloud; waiting changes are sent right after.
syncBanner.joinTitle: Not in OpenBeach yet: matches stay on this device
syncBanner.joinBody: This OpenVolley account can join OpenBeach with the same login. Once an invite code or an admin approves it, the waiting matches are sent.

connectTablets.btAlternative: Choose “Wi-Fi from this computer” instead: it works for every tablet.
connectTablets.btAndroid: Android: Settings › Bluetooth › pair with “{{name}}”, tap ⚙ next to it and switch on “Internet access”. If it does not connect, switch the tablet’s Wi-Fi off.
connectTablets.btDesktopOnly: The OpenBeach desktop app on Linux can open a Bluetooth network for the tablets. Windows cannot (it can only join one).
connectTablets.btFound: Bluetooth network found: tablets paired with this computer can scan the codes.
connectTablets.btIpad: iPad (may not work): Settings › Bluetooth › tap “{{name}}”.
connectTablets.btThen: Then scan the role’s code. Bluetooth is slow and fits about 6 devices.
connectTablets.cloudBlocked: Cloud sync is off for this app window (it does not run on port 5174). Choose Venue Wi-Fi or Wi-Fi from this computer.
connectTablets.description: The referee follows this match on their own tablet. Three steps: choose the connection, pick a tablet, scan and enter its PIN.

err.bluetoothFailed: The Bluetooth network could not be started.
err.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is switched off and could not be switched on.
err.busy: The hotspot is still switching. Wait a moment and try again.
err.hardware: The Wi-Fi adapter of this computer cannot host a hotspot.
err.hotspotFailed: The Wi-Fi for the tablets could not be started.
err.invalidCredentials: The network name or password is not valid.
err.noAdapter: This computer has no Bluetooth adapter.
err.noApMode: The Wi-Fi adapter of this computer cannot act as an access point.
err.noBluez: The Bluetooth service (BlueZ) is not running on this computer.
err.noNetworkManager: NetworkManager is not running on this computer, so the app cannot create a Wi-Fi.
err.noProfile: Windows found no network connection to start the Mobile Hotspot from.
err.noWifiDevice: This computer has no Wi-Fi adapter.
err.notAuthorized: Your user account may not create networks. Ask an administrator, or log in at the computer itself (not over remote access).
err.notDesktop: Only the OpenBeach desktop app can do this.
err.policy: Mobile Hotspot is turned off by your organisation (group policy).
err.radio: The Wi-Fi radio refused the hotspot (band or country restriction). Try again, or use a travel router.
err.unsupportedOs: The app cannot create networks on this system.
err.wifiOff: Wi-Fi is switched off on this computer (airplane mode?). Switch it on and try again.
err.windowsBluetooth: Windows cannot host a Bluetooth network for tablets: it can only join one.

connectTablets.hallIntro: Tablets join the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
connectTablets.hotspotDesktopOnly: The OpenBeach desktop app (Windows, Linux) can create its own Wi-Fi for the tablets, with no router and no internet.
connectTablets.joinAndroid: Android: Settings › Wi-Fi › QR icon (or the camera), scan the Wi-Fi code.
connectTablets.joinIpad: iPad: open the Camera, point it at the Wi-Fi code, tap “Join”.
connectTablets.joinNoInternet: “No internet”? Choose “Stay connected”, then scan the role’s code.
connectTablets.lanNeedsServer: Tablets on the local network need the OpenBeach desktop app (or a venue box) on this computer: it serves the referee and livescore pages. In a browser, choose Internet.
connectTablets.needsAdmin: Your system may ask for an administrator password.
connectTablets.noHallNetwork: This computer is on no network. Connect it to the venue Wi-Fi, or create a Wi-Fi for the tablets.
connectTablets.serverHint: Tablets need internet (venue Wi-Fi or mobile data).
connectTablets.takesOverWifi: This computer leaves its current Wi-Fi while the tablets’ Wi-Fi is on. Cloud sync pauses unless it is on a network cable.
connectTablets.title: Connect tablets
connectTablets.travelRouter: No venue Wi-Fi? A small travel router works too, no internet needed: switch it on, connect this computer and the tablets to it, then choose Venue Wi-Fi.
connectTablets.wifiDirect: Windows’ mobile hotspot is unavailable here: a direct Wi-Fi network is used instead.
connectTablets.hotspotExternal: This computer’s hotspot was switched on in the system settings. Tablets on it can scan the codes; switch it off there.
connectTablets.windowsFirewall: Tablets join but the page does not load? Windows Security › Firewall & network protection › Allow an app through firewall › OpenBeach › tick “Public”.
connectTablets.btExternal: This Bluetooth network was not started by this app run. Stop it in the system’s network settings.

confirm.leaveMessage: This computer leaves {{network}}: tablets on it disconnect and cloud sync pauses until the computer is back on it (or on a network cable).

card.off: Off · turn on to show its PIN
card.remote: On · status not visible over the internet

footer.thisNetworkOnly: Live status shows tablets on this network only

connectTablets.isolationTip: Page does not load on the tablet? Some venue Wi-Fis keep devices apart: choose Wi-Fi from this computer or Internet instead.
connectTablets.noMatchText: Codes and PINs belong to a match.
connectTablets.otherScorerText: Opens a separate scorer app with its own matches. It does not follow this match.

reason.cannotCreateWifi: This computer cannot create a Wi-Fi
reason.cloudBlocked: Cloud is off in this app window
reason.needsLinuxDesktop: Needs the desktop app on Linux
reason.needsServer: Needs the desktop app or a venue box
reason.noNetwork: This computer is on no network
reason.windowsBluetooth: Windows cannot host a Bluetooth network

scan.instruction: Scan with the tablet’s camera, then enter this PIN:
scan.noPin: This tablet has no PIN yet. Set one in Match setup.
scan.noPinInLink: Links and codes never contain the PIN.
scan.off: {{role}} is off. A tablet that scans now is told its PIN is wrong.
scan.public: Scan with any phone or screen. No PIN needed.
scan.remote: Ask them to confirm they are in
scan.title: {{role}} tablet

connectTablets.serverNotSynced: The match is not in the cloud yet. Tablets find it once sync shows Synced.
connectTablets.serverSignIn: Sign in so tablets can find this match on the internet.

transport.bluetoothWhen: Last resort when no Wi-Fi works. Linux only.
transport.hallWhen: The venue has Wi-Fi and this computer is on it.
transport.laptopWhen: No venue Wi-Fi, or tablets cannot reach this computer on it. No internet needed.
transport.serverWhen: Tablets have mobile data, or the venue Wi-Fi keeps devices apart. Sign-in needed.

connectTablets.wifiQrCaption: Scan to join this Wi-Fi first

banner.readOnly: The match is approved: corrections are read-only.
banner.signaturesCleared: Signatures were cleared because the sheet changed. Collect them again at the match end.

chip.teamsNotSetBeach: Team A/B not set yet: team 1 is shown as A

confirm.removePoint: The point it gave is still the last point of this set. Remove it as well (as Undo would)?
confirm.timeoutFree: {{team}} can take its time-out of set {{set}} again.

error.endBeforeStart: Set {{set}} cannot end before it starts.
error.forfeitOnScoreboard: An expulsion or a disqualification forfeits the set or the match: give it on the scoreboard.
error.invalidFinalScore: {{score}} is not a possible final score of set {{set}}.
error.ladder: By the rules this is a {{expected}} (the team's earlier sanctions).
error.noLaterOpponentPoint: {{team}} has no later point in set {{set}} to mark as the penalty point. If the point was never recorded, give the penalty on the scoreboard (during the match) or use "Correct final score".
error.notLastPoint: The last point of set {{set}} was not won by {{team}}.
error.removePointNotLast: The penalty point can only be removed while it is the last point of the set being played.
error.sameSanctionTwice: This player already has this sanction.
error.subEvent: This row belongs to another entry; remove that entry instead.
error.teamAlreadyWarned: The team has already been warned: one misconduct warning per team per match.
error.thirdPenalty: #{{n}} already has two penalties in set {{set}}: a third is an expulsion, given on the scoreboard.
error.timeoutLimit: This team's time-out of set {{set}} is already recorded (one per team per set).
error.useUndo: This entry is corrected with Undo or Reopen set, not removed here.
error.winnerWouldChange: This would change who won set {{set}}. Use "Reopen last set" or ask the referee.

corrections.help: Each correction is saved when you confirm it and is listed in the correction log for the referee.

hint.advanced: Every entry of the match log. Removing an entry removes everything that belongs to it. Use the cards above to add or change entries.
hint.finalScoreBeach: Only the end of the set can be corrected: a point added at the end, or the last point removed. Sets are won at 21 (the third at 15) with two points ahead.
hint.forfeitSanctions: An expulsion or a disqualification is given on the scoreboard: it forfeits the set or the match.
hint.penaltyPoint: The penalty point is {{team}}'s next point after this score; it must already be recorded.
hint.timeoutsBeach: One time-out per team per set. The technical time-out is not corrected here.

note.circledPoint: {{team}}'s point at {{score}} becomes the circled penalty point.
note.courtSwitches: The changes of courts recorded after this point are not moved.
note.ladder: By the rules this would have been a {{expected}}; recorded as the referee decided.
note.penaltyNotNext: The rally after {{score}} was won by {{team}}, not by the opponent: check that the sanction was given at this score.
note.pointStays: The point stays as a normal rally point (no longer circled).
note.sameSanctionTwice: This player already has this sanction.
note.teamAlreadyWarned: The team had already been warned (one misconduct warning per team per match).
note.thirdPenalty: #{{n}} already had two penalties in set {{set}} (a third is an expulsion); recorded as the referee decided.

preview.paperTimeout: "T" at {{score}} in the time-out box of {{team}}, set {{set}}.
preview.title: What changes on the scoresheet

corrections.saveError: The correction could not be saved: {{message}}
corrections.title: Corrections

phoneSign.scanHint: Scan with the phone camera. Keep this window open until the signature arrives.
phoneSign.copyFailedUseQr: Copying is not allowed here: scan the QR code instead.
phoneSign.opened: Opened on a phone. Waiting for the signature…
phoneSign.expired: The link has expired. Make a new one.
phoneSign.cancelled: Signing on the phone was cancelled.
phoneSign.hallBlocked: Phone can’t open it? Some hall Wi-Fis block devices from reaching each other. Use the laptop’s own Wi-Fi or the internet.
phoneSign.reasonNone: Sign on phone needs the internet or the hall network. Neither is available here: sign on this device.
phoneSign.reasonSignIn: Sign in to sign on a phone over the internet. Or sign on this device.
phoneSign.reasonRole: Your account can’t start phone signing yet. Sign on this device.
phoneSign.reasonNoNetwork: No network for phones: connect this laptop to the hall Wi-Fi or turn on its own Wi-Fi (Connect tablets).
phoneSign.startFailed: Could not make a link. Try again, or sign on this device.

pin.title: Approval PIN
pin.explainer: Approve match results with your account instead of a drawn signature. Your personal PIN, not a match PIN. Never share it.
pin.disabled: Blocked after too many wrong PINs. Set a new one.

ineligible.role: Needs the referee or scorer role

pin.passwordHint: Your account password confirms the change.
pin.rule: 4 to 6 digits. No date, no year and no pattern such as 1212 or 1234.
pin.removeConfirmBody: You can no longer approve results with your account until you set a new PIN.

approval.pinHint: The official types their own approval PIN. It is set in their profile.
approval.stale: Result changed. Approve again or sign
approval.undoConfirmBody: The official then approves again or signs by hand.
approval.nameDiffers: Account name {{account}} differs from the official entered ({{entered}})
approval.revalidateFailed: An account approval is no longer valid. Check the signatures and approve again.

errors.pinInvalid: Email or PIN not accepted. After several wrong PINs the PIN pauses: the official sees it in their profile. Or sign by hand.
errors.pinFormat: The PIN must have 4 to 6 digits.
errors.pinWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid dates, years and patterns such as 1212, 2580 or 1234.
errors.roleRequired: This account does not have the role for this signature.
errors.notMatchScorer: Only the scorer of this match can approve as scorer.
errors.nameRequired: The account has no name. Add it in the profile first.
errors.oneSlot: This account has already approved another signature of this match.
errors.slotTaken: Someone else has already approved this signature.
errors.matchNotEnded: The match has not ended on the server yet. Wait for the sync, then try again.
errors.resultNotSynced: The result has not reached the server yet. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unsupported: This server does not approve beach results with a PIN yet: sign by hand.
errors.unavailable: Approval with an account is not available on this server.
errors.emailUnconfirmed: The official has not confirmed the email address of the account yet.
errors.scorerNotReferee: The account that scores this match cannot approve as a referee.
errors.callerRole: Approving with an account needs a scorer or referee account on this device.
errors.offline: This needs a connection to the server.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: This account may not do that.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mine.title: Your approvals
mine.hint: Every approval made with your PIN. If one was not you, undo it while the match is open and change your PIN.
mine.undoBody: The approval no longer counts. The match is then approved again or signed by hand.

why.signOnly: Signature only: the assistant scorer does not approve with a PIN
why.locked: Match approved or closed: approvals can no longer change
why.localMatch: This match is not saved online: approval with a PIN needs an online match
why.noCloud: No online connection on this device: sign by hand
why.serverOff: Approval with a PIN is turned off on this server
why.signedOut: Sign in on this device to approve with a PIN
why.callerRole: The account on this device cannot send approvals: it needs the scorer or referee role
why.offline: Offline: approval with a PIN is offered again when back online
why.beachOff: This server does not approve beach results with a PIN yet: sign by hand

scoresheet.closeCancels: Closing this window cancels the match approval.
scoresheet.wait: Please wait while the scoresheet is converted.
scoresheet.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be made: {{error}}
scoresheet.sent: It went to the match end page. You can close this window.
